title: Skilled birth attendance, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World, by wealth
headline: Worldwide in 2025: 87.2% of births attended by skilled health personnel
subtitle: Proportion of births attended by skilled health personnel (generally doctors, nurses or midwives but can refer to other health professionals providing childbirth care) is the proportion of childbirths attended by skilled health personnel.
years: From 86.7% in SIDS to 76.0% in LLDCs.
data_line: Data: UNICEF and WHO via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_STA_BRTC, extracted 1 Nov 2026
